title: promtool test rules panics when an alerting rule has empty annotations
body:
### What did you do?

Ran `promtool test rules tests.yml` against a rule file whose alerting rule has an empty `annotations:` map.

### What did you expect to see?

The unit tests run and pass or fail normally.

### What did you see instead? Under which circumstances?

promtool panics before running any test.

### System information

Linux 6.8

### Prometheus version

```text
promtool, version 3.13.4
```

### Prometheus configuration file

```yaml
groups:
  - name: example
    rules:
      - alert: HighLatency
        expr: job:request_latency_seconds:mean5m > 0.5
        annotations: {}
```

### Logs

```text
panic: assignment to entry in nil map
```
